meta.title: Game launcher
meta.description: Open App hosting from the left sidebar, then click Open game in the Game card at the top of the page to launch the local sandbox game (Godot) without a terminal and run.sh. The card shows the running state and refreshes every five seconds; it starts solo mode by default, the game window runs independently of DSH and stays open after DSH quits, and the button reads Running instead of opening another window while it is up. The App hosting plugin (@local/app-host) must be enabled, because the card renders inside its page. The plugin registers a same-origin-only local endpoint, /api/game-launcher/launch, to start the game and does not read or upload any game data.
